<subject>coordination with London office</subject>
<body>
I spoke with David Grant and Emily Foster this morning regarding TRR Logistics and the London process.

David has prepared both in-the-money and out-of-the-money lists which he will send over for Perth to review and confirm counterparty termination details. I believe London can adopt our recently developed procedures as a framework. David and team will join the 9:30 a.m. conference call on March 12.

Tom and Bjorn: Could you please send David a copy of the "Coastal Gas Supplies Pty Ltd" template, or if updated, the latest version? Also, the "Risk Management Book Liquidation" template?

Alan: Could you provide David and Emily with the decision tree diagram and settlement process flowchart?

If the handouts for tomorrow are ready and include these, they should be sufficient for London’s use.

Thanks.
